title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06

ai_review.summary: Stunning matrix capture of an on‑fire Philadelphia show with blazing Shakedown and a Crazy Fingers tease.
ai_review.review: All five reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear matrix mix, calling it “amazing” and “beautiful.” The performance is described as “on fire,” especially noting the Shakedown/​Crazy Fingers tease and the energy of the night in Philadelphia. No criticisms are mentioned, making this both a superb sonic document and a high‑energy concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews praising both the show’s energy and the matrix recording quality; no negative comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight crystal‑clear, balanced sound with no noted flaws—described as possibly the best version of this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic, high‑energy flow that kept the crowd engaged throughout; highlighted by a fiery second half.
